newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH REAL ESTATE MARKETS PICKING UP - ARSENAL.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH REAL ESTATE MARKETS PICKING UP - ARSENAL.

text.p: Demand for real estate increased strongly in the beginning of the year, asset management company Arsenal said on Thursday in a statement.
The majority of 134 real estate experts interviewed in a survey commissioned by Arsenal expected demand for real estate to grow further during the next 12 months, it said.
"Trade in flats is particularly expected to continue to pick up," it said.
The rise in prices of apartments was expected to accelerate, but price rise expectations for other premises were more cautious, Arsenal said.
Rents were expected to rise slightly stronger than prices, it said.
Sales and leasing of commercial premises increased clearly earlier this year, and the favourable trend is expected to continue, Arsenal said.
